title: Purple Aura Martial Artist
description: A young female warrior with white hair in an updo stands in a dynamic high kick pose. She wears a white and purple traditional Chinese martial arts uniform with purple accents and holds crackling purple energy orbs in both hands, surrounded by a glowing purple halo of energy.
